subject: file-access
detail: A scopes every file action by owner_id; C has no owner concept, so any caller could create or revoke a link for any file_id
solutions: Owner-only link create/revoke; a token grants read-only access to that one file
Let anyone with the file id share it (weakens A's owner scoping)
recommended: Owner-only link create/revoke; a valid token (and password, if set) grants read-only metadata, preview and download of that one file

subject: owner
detail: No source authenticates anyone: A takes owner_id from the caller and C has no identity at all, yet the merged app must know who owns a file
solutions: Minimal accounts: username + password (salted PBKDF2), opaque session token in an http-only cookie
recommended: Minimal accounts with a salted PBKDF2 password and a server-side session in an http-only cookie (standard library only)

subject: link-password-hash
detail: C stores link passwords as unsalted SHA-256 and compares with !=; the unified app's rule is a slow salted hash and constant-time compare

subject: file-delete-links
detail: Deleting a file in A would leave C's links pointing at a missing file_id
solutions: Delete a file's share links with it (foreign key ON DELETE CASCADE)
Keep links and return 404 when opened
recommended: ON DELETE CASCADE from share_links.file_id to files.id

subject: file-bytes
detail: A's files table has no column for the file's bytes, but B's preview needs them
solutions: Store bytes in a separate SQLite BLOB table keyed by file id (max 10 MB each)
Store bytes on disk under a data folder
recommended: Separate file_content table (file_id primary key, data BLOB) so listing never loads bytes

subject: thumbnail-url
detail: B returns /thumbs/<id>.png but nothing creates or serves it, and resizing needs an imaging library the standard library lacks
solutions: Preview URL points at a route that serves the original image (owner route or link route)
recommended: Serve the original image with its content type at /api/files/<id>/content (owner) or /s/<token>/content (link)
